title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: siconfir R package provides direct access fiscal data SICONFI (Accounting Fiscal Information System Brazilian Public Sector) Brazilian National Treasury’s API. allows query data Brazilian states municipalities, including fiscal reports RREO, RGF, DCA, Accounting Balances Matrix (MSC).

title: Getting Started with siconfir
code: # Install from CRAN (when available) install.packages("siconfir")  # Or the development version from GitHub # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("StrategicProjects/siconfir")

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: Every function available two forms: English interface English parameter names, Portuguese interface matching original API parameter names. produce identical results – use whichever prefer: English functions also translate parameter names. example, fiscal_year maps an_exercicio, entity_id id_ente, . See function’s help page full mapping. Note function parameter names English, parameter values must still Portuguese come API (e.g., appendix = "RREO-Anexo 01").

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: common starting point list available entities. need IBGE code (cod_ibge) queries. can filter state, region, government sphere:
code: library(siconfir) library(dplyr)  entes <- get_entities() entes # State capitals capitals <- entes |>   filter(capital == 1)  # Municipalities in the state of Pernambuco municipalities_pe <- entes |>   filter(uf == "PE", esfera == "M")

what: Query the RREO (Budget Execution Summary Report)
title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: RREO published bimonthly. Use get_budget_report() (get_rreo()):
code: rreo <- get_budget_report(   fiscal_year = 2023,   period      = 6,   report_type = "RREO",   appendix    = "RREO-Anexo 01",   sphere      = "E",   entity_id   = 26 # Pernambuco )

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: RGF published every four months:
code: rgf <- get_fiscal_report(   fiscal_year = 2023,   periodicity = "Q",   period      = 3,   report_type = "RGF",   appendix    = "RGF-Anexo 01",   sphere      = "E",   branch      = "E",   entity_id   = 26 )

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: DCA contains annual balance sheet data:
code: dca <- get_annual_accounts(fiscal_year = 2023, entity_id = 26)

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: find reports entity submitted:
code: status <- get_delivery_status(entity_id = 26, year = 2023)

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: MSC provides detailed accounting data, split three segments: equity/assets (classes 1–4), budgetary (5–6), control (7–8).
code: # Equity/asset accounts msc_equity <- get_msc_equity(   entity_id     = 26,   year          = 2023,   month         = 12,   matrix_type   = "MSCC",   account_class = 1,   value_type    = "ending_balance" )  # Budgetary accounts msc_budget <- get_msc_budget(   entity_id     = 26,   year          = 2023,   month         = 12,   matrix_type   = "MSCC",   account_class = 6,   value_type    = "period_change" )

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: package maintains -memory cache duration R session. call function parameters, data returned cache without hitting API . clear cache: can also disable cache specific call:
code: siconfir_clear_cache() entes <- get_entes(use_cache = FALSE)

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: SICONFI API returns maximum 5,000 rows per page. siconfir handles pagination automatically, following hasMore / offset pattern data retrieved. Informative messages indicate many pages fetched many rows returned.

title: Getting Started with siconfir
text: Use get_anexos() query reference table listing available appendices report type government sphere:
code: anexos <- get_anexos()  # Appendices available for the municipal RREO anexos |>   filter(esfera == "M", str_detect(anexo, "RREO"))

what: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API
title: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API
text: siconfir provides tidy, modern interface SICONFI API Brazil’s National Treasury (Secretaria Tesouro Nacional). lets access fiscal data Brazilian states municipalities directly R.

title: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API
code: # Install from CRAN (when available) install.packages("siconfir")  # Or install the development version from GitHub # install.packages("pak") pak::pak("StrategicProjects/siconfir")

title: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API
text: Tidyverse-friendly: functions return tibbles snake_case column names. Automatic pagination: Fetches pages results transparently. -memory caching: Avoids redundant API calls within session. Informative messages: Uses cli clear progress error messages. Modern HTTP: Built httr2 automatic retries.

title: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API
text: functions return tibbles. English aliases English parameter names provided functions.

title: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API
code: library(siconfir)  # List all entities entes <- get_entities()  # Budget Execution Summary (RREO) -- English interface rreo <- get_budget_report(   fiscal_year = 2022, period = 6,   report_type = "RREO", appendix = "RREO-Anexo 01",   sphere = "E", entity_id = 17  # Tocantins )  # Same call using the Portuguese interface: # rreo <- get_rreo( #   an_exercicio = 2022, nr_periodo = 6, #   co_tipo_demonstrativo = "RREO", no_anexo = "RREO-Anexo 01", #   co_esfera = "E", id_ente = 17 # )  # Fiscal Management Report (RGF) for Sao Paulo city rgf <- get_fiscal_report(   fiscal_year = 2022, periodicity = "Q", period = 3,   report_type = "RGF", appendix = "RGF-Anexo 01",   sphere = "M", branch = "E", entity_id = 3550308 )  # Annual accounts for Rondonia dca <- get_annual_accounts(fiscal_year = 2022, entity_id = 11)  # Clear the cache if needed siconfir_clear_cache()

title: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API
text: SICONFI API provided Brazilian National Treasury : API returns 5,000 rows per page. siconfir handles pagination automatically, following hasMore / offset pattern data retrieved. Rate limit: API allows one request per second. package uses httr2::req_retry() handle transient errors gracefully.

Period number (1-3 four-monthly, 1-2 semi-annual). Required. co_tipo_demonstrativo Character. Report type: "RGF" "RGF Simplificado". Required. no_anexo Character. Appendix name (e.g., "RGF-Anexo 01"). Required. co_esfera Character. Government sphere: "M" (municipalities), "E" (states), "U" (union). Required. co_poder Character. Government branch: "E" (executive), "L" (legislative), "J" (judiciary), "M" (public ministry), "D" (public defender). Required. id_ente Integer. IBGE code entity. Required. use_cache Logical. TRUE (default), uses -memory cache.

what: siconfir: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API — siconfir-package
title: siconfir: Access Brazilian Fiscal Data from SICONFI API — siconfir-package
text: Provides functions access fiscal data Brazilian National Treasury's SICONFI API https://apidatalake.tesouro.gov.br/docs/siconfi/. Includes budget execution reports (RREO), fiscal management reports (RGF), annual accounts declarations (DCA), accounting balances matrices (MSC), entity information Brazilian states municipalities. Features automatic pagination, -memory caching, tidy output.

title: siconfir 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN release. Added get_anexos() report appendix reference table. Added get_entes() government entities listing. Added get_dca() Annual Accounts Declaration data. Added get_extrato() delivery status extract. Added get_rreo() Budget Execution Summary Report data. Added get_rgf() Fiscal Management Report data. Added get_msc_controle() MSC control accounts (classes 7-8). Added get_msc_orcamentaria() MSC budgetary accounts (classes 5-6). Added get_msc_patrimonial() MSC equity/asset accounts (classes 1-4). English aliases English parameter names: get_entities(), get_annexes(), get_annual_accounts(), get_delivery_status(), get_budget_report(), get_fiscal_report(), get_msc_control(), get_msc_budget(), get_msc_equity(). functions return tibbles. Automatic pagination fetch pages results. -memory session cache siconfir_clear_cache(). Built httr2 automatic retries. Informative CLI messages via cli.
